faq.q: How do I know the open house time on the page is current?
faq.a: Check it carefully and confirm it: on the labelled cards read for this file, the card's top time block (labelled PST) is exactly one hour later than the "Open House on..." line under it, and the time inside the listing text agrees with the block in four of five text-bearing cases and with neither in the fifth — confirm the time with the listing brokerage before you go.

faq.q: Does every listing on the Cloverdale open-houses page hold an open house?
faq.a: Not on the evidence of the first page: 11 of the 12 cards carried an open-house time block and one Clayton townhouse card carried no open-house label or time at all in the page text, so treat an unlabelled card as a listing to confirm privately, not as an open house.
